model.name: firmware-constants-audit
model.method: header literal/product evaluation under IEEE-754 double semantics vs the certified engine, bit-level (float.hex) comparison; formula identity check over a probe grid; usage scan

payload.chain_note: a prior seal of this same audit landed as seq 13 but its artifact write crashed (missing import); this receipt is the complete record of the same audit content; seq 13's payload is recoverable from the chain line itself

checks.statement: PHI_SQ_INV product vs engine (same product formula)
MU_0 (4e-7 * pi literal) vs engine (4e-7 * math.pi)

checks.observed: chain 40134.94616603812 vs pow 40134.94616603813; hex DIFFER; ulp -1 (pow vs repeated-multiply semantics — a 1-ulp evaluation-order difference of the SAME mathematical value, ~2.4e-12 relative; the engine's own assertion compares at 1e-3 Hz, both far inside; A9 shows the header is the constant's only use — zero compute impact)

checks.statement: device phiMotion(x,k) vs engine phi_motion(x,k) — bitwise, 11-point probe grid (both expressions carry the identical operation order and literals)
checks.expected: finite(0.0,1.0) == PHI_SQ_INV bitwise; all 11 points hex-equal

checks.statement: device constant 1.2041 kg/m3 vs engine computed rho (20 C, 101.325 kPa, 0 %RH)
checks.observed: device 1.2041; relative dev 1.27e-05 (the declared table value vs the computed value; compute impact: ug/m3->ppm conversions shift in the 5th significant digit — display-scale, thresholds are self-consistent device-side)

checks.statement: battery.cpp's reference moment evaluated both ways (phiMotion(ugM3ToPpm(0.6137), 1.0))
checks.observed: device 0.382790683170125 ppm; digit shift 2.73e-08 relative — the same n*10^-5 order as A7, spoken there; the device's own battery compares against the device's own reference (self-consistent)

checks.expected: no compute-path usage (the reading chain never consumes it)
checks.observed: 1 reference(s): include\law2396.h:17: constexpr double LADDER_INVARIANT_HZ = BASE_FREQUENCY * PHI_P9;

payload.verdict: FIRMWARE CONSTANTS AUDIT: PASS with spoken deviations — formulas and constants hex-equal everywhere they compute; the remaining rows are spoken evaluation-order and declared-rounding notes with display-scale impact

honesty.REAL: IEEE-754 bit comparisons, the engine source of truth, the source usage scan
honesty.MODEL: the air-density rounding (the declared table value), the device battery's self-consistent reference
